rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a long, narrow crack in rock, earth, or a solid object.

example.english: A long fissure has appeared in this stone wall.
example.traditional: 呢幅石牆出現咗條長長嘅裂縫。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 sek6 coeng4 ceot1 jin6 zo2 tiu4 coeng4 coeng4 ge3 lit6 fung6

rows.note: Use this for an actual split or tear in body tissue, especially a small tear in the skin or a mucous membrane.

example.english: The doctor said I had a small fissure.
example.traditional: 醫生話我肛門有條細裂口。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ngo5 gong1 mun4 jau5 tiu4 sai3 lit6 hau2

rows.note: Use this for the groove or furrow aspect of a bodily fissure rather than an actual tear or opening.

example.english: The scan found a deep fissure in his brain.
example.traditional: 掃描見到佢個腦入面有條好深嘅溝。
example.jyutping: sou3 miu4 gin3 dou2 keoi5 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 jau5 tiu4 hou2 sam1 ge3 kau1
